Synopsis:
Dialogue with Meygan in Last Light. She is standing before an altar, mourning Yonas' death. She might give us something if we give her his sword. Despite changes in the state of the grove, she usually reverts to her normal dialogue/ state of sadness as she was close to Yonas and that's more to the front of her mind than stuff like Ketheric

Cluster Contexts:
- HAV_HarperScouts_Harper_001.json: The player is in the Shadow‑cursed lands at Last Light, shortly after a confrontation with shadow‑tainted creatures in which a Harper scout named Yonas was snatched/turned and later found dead or missing. Meygan is one of the surviving Harper scouts, visibly grieving and emotionally close to Yonas (she calls him a friend and comrade and even hints they might once have become “something more”), so her grief is the driving focus of her lines. Off‑screen, the Harpers are wary of the player (the scouts initially challenged the party) and are trying to move survivors toward the nearby Last Light Inn for safety and recovery. If the player recovered Yonas’s sword, offering it to Meygan prompts a surprised, grateful response as she accepts it to honor him; conversely the player can choose to keep it.
- HAV_HarperScouts_Harper_000.json: Dialogue in Haven for one of the harper scouts you helped in SCL (SCL_HarperScouts_ShadowCreatures). She is mourning Yonas' death and gives some information about the shadow curse.
- SCL_HarperScouts_PostCombat_HarperScout_001.json: The player has just survived a fight with shadow‑touched creatures after entering territory already known to be cursed; a small knot of Harper scouts (including Lassandra, Meygan, and the missing Yonas) had been patrolling with torches and urging everyone to “keep to the light.” The Harpers are on edge and suspicious of the player because of prior tensions, weapons drawn as they probe the dark incline. During the attack Yonas was snatched and later revealed transformed or killed by the curse, and Meygan—who is close to him (off‑screen noted as a comrade and lover)—is briefly grieving. Meygan offers to lead the player to the Last Light Inn, a nearby magically protected refuge the Harpers mark as the only safe spot on the outskirts, and urges haste and to avoid lingering in the shadows. Different Harper scouts may speak slightly different lines here depending on who survived.
- SCL_HarperScouts_Dead_HarperScout_000.json: Speak with dead dialogue with Lassandra, a harper scout. The player can ask her corpse, who she is, what she was doing etc, possibly learning of Last Light, a nearby refuge against shadow curse.
- DEN_AttackOnDen_BirdSender.json: This dialogue takes place in two different states. The first is after the player has successfully fought back an army of goblins that attacked the druid grove. In the second state, the goblin leaders have been killed and the tieflings in the grove are leaving. She's aware of the hard work ahead required to make things go back to normal, but she's hopeful all the same.There's an extra node to acknowledge the missing idol, if it went missing before one of those two states were triggered.

context: You find Meygan at Last Light, standing before an altar and mourning Yonas, a fellow Harper who was taken in a shadow‑tainted ambush and later found dead or missing. Off‑screen the surviving Harper scouts are on edge and wary of the player, trying to shepherd survivors toward the nearby Last Light Inn as the only safe refuge. Meygan was close to Yonas—comrade and possibly something more—so her grief drives her lines and reactions. If you recovered Yonas’s sword, offering it will typically elicit a surprised, grateful acceptance as she takes it to honor him; alternatively you can keep the blade.
